keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Celta Vigo 1, Union Saint-Gilloise 0. Pablo Durán (Celta Vigo) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Sergio Carreira.
Goal! Celta Vigo 1, Union Saint-Gilloise 1. Besfort Zeneli (Union Saint-Gilloise) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Adem Zorgane with a through ball.
First Half ends, Celta Vigo 1, Union Saint-Gilloise 1.
Second Half begins Celta Vigo 1, Union Saint-Gilloise 1.

Goal! Celta Vigo 1, Union Saint-Gilloise 2. Besfort Zeneli (Union Saint-Gilloise) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Kevin Rodríguez.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Iago Aspas replaces Aleix Febas.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Ilaix Moriba replaces Hugo Álvarez.
Substitution, Union Saint-Gilloise. Dylan Aquino replaces Adem Zorgane.
Substitution, Union Saint-Gilloise. Denzel De Roeve replaces Kevin Rodríguez.
Guilherme Smith (Union Saint-Gilloise) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Couhaib Driouech replaces Williot Swedberg.
Penalty saved. Besfort Zeneli (Union Saint-Gilloise) right footed shot saved in the bottom right corner by Ionut Radu (Celta Vigo).
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Ferran Jutglà replaces Javi Rueda.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Andrés Antañón replaces Hugo Burcio.
Substitution, Union Saint-Gilloise. Ilan Hurtevent replaces Guilherme Smith.
Substitution, Union Saint-Gilloise. Ross Sykes replaces Nikki Havenaar.
Substitution, Union Saint-Gilloise. Darius Olaru replaces Relebohile Mofokeng.
Pablo Durán (Celta Vigo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Celta Vigo 1, Union Saint-Gilloise 2.
